purpose: If the published Koomen paired-shape discrepancy survives mathematical certification, distinguish frozen-surrogate behavior from direct MYSTIC behavior at a geometry subset selected by symmetry rather than residual magnitude.

source.dataset: Koomen et al. 1952 JOSA Table II Maryland

selection.selectionRule: Cartesian product of two interior target-altitude strata and two canonical cross/opposite-solar azimuth strata; both H=-3 and H=-6 are always included.

atmosphereGrid.reason: Use low, interior-reference, and upper frozen AOD values and the complete already-frozen five-state aerosol scenario set; no state is chosen from Koomen agreement.

proposedExecution.seedPolicy: Fresh deterministic seeds must be derived under a new stage-specific namespace and frozen before execution. The same seed is proposed for the H=3/H=6 pair within a fixed target-altitude/azimuth/AOD/scenario group to permit common-random-number variance reduction; seed reuse across unrelated groups is forbidden.
proposedExecution.numericalMethod: Reuse the exact reviewed MYSTIC full-spectrum execution stack and runtime identity already bound in the repository; no alternative solver/runtime is permitted without versioning this contract.

primaryDiagnostic.comparison1: direct MYSTIC paired log ratio versus frozen Level-B+ASIV paired log ratio at identical inputs
primaryDiagnostic.comparison2: direct MYSTIC paired log ratio versus published Koomen paired log ratio
primaryDiagnostic.surrogateVsMysticInterpretation: If direct MYSTIC and the frozen surrogate agree within their combined numerical/MC uncertainty while both differ from Koomen, the discrepancy points to physical/model-form or historical-source differences rather than surrogate transport. If direct MYSTIC materially differs from the surrogate in the direction needed to explain Koomen, investigate surrogate transport before model-form conclusions.
